recommendations.name: Greptile auto-approve
recommendations.description: Approves a PR only on a clean 5/5 review at or below a risk cap you set (start at Low), works on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Gitea, and reads its policy from the base branch so a PR can't loosen it; it is still in beta.

recommendations.name: cubic auto-approval
recommendations.description: Offers a Low-risk-only or custom policy with a Shadow mode that shows what it would approve before going live, but its docs only mention GitHub.

recommendations.name: Cursor PR Routing & Approval
recommendations.description: Approves low-risk PRs against your own criteria and a maximum-risk threshold, with per-directory APPROVAL_POLICY.md files, but it supports only GitHub and Origin repos and is not a full code review.
